raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ### What does this PR do? integrates [atropos](https://github.com/NousResearch/atropos) RL environments with verl's GRPO training pipeline. envs handle generation and scoring; this recipe polls scored batches and trains with verl's FSDP actor + internal vLLM. closes #1782 recipe submodule PR: https://github.com/verl-project/verl-recipe/pull/61 (merged) upstream atropos fixes: https://github.com/NousResearch/atropos/pull/408 (merged) ### Results **30-step training run:** Qwen3-4B, `math_server_zero`, 4xA100-SXM4-80GB W&B: [trainer run](https://wandb.ai/daspartho/verl-atropos/runs/pzezvwnk) (28/30 steps logged) · [env run](https://wandb.ai/daspartho/verl-atropos/runs/kxsphr9h) (5 eval points) training accuracy 5.8%→83%, held-out eval reaching 65% overall across 5 benchmarks (MATH-500, AMC23, Olympiad, AIME24, Minerva) in 25 steps. per-benchmark eval breakdown (MATH-500, AMC23, Olympiad, AIME24, Minerva) available in the [env W&B run](https://wandb.ai/daspartho/verl-atropos/runs/kxsphr9h). **reproduce:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/verl-project/verl.git && cd verl git submodule update --init pip install -e ".[vllm,atropos]" git clone https://github.com/NousResearch/atropos.git ../atropos pip install -e ../atropos N_GPUS=4 MODEL=Qwen/Qwen3-4B ATROPOS_ENV=math_server_zero TOTAL_STEPS=30 \ BATCH_SIZE=32 GROUP_SIZE=8 MICRO_BATCH_SIZE=4 GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.50 \ PARAM_OFFLOAD=false OPTIMIZER_OFFLOAD=false ENTROPY_COEFF=0 GRAD_CLIP=0.5 \ MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH=512 MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH=4096 SAVE_FREQ=999 STEPS_PER_EVAL=5 \ bash recipe/atropos/run_atropos.sh ``` hydra overrides added in `run_atropos.sh` for this run: ``` actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=true actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.01 actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=4 actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len=8192 actor_rollout_ref.rollout.update_weights_bucket_megabytes=4096 ``` usage and configuration documented in `recipe/atropos/README.md`. ### Design & Code Changes #### core verl changes (3 files) - **`setup.py`** — `extras_require["atropos"]` with httpx dependency - **`verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py`** + **`ray_trainer.py`** — `token_level_advantages` passthrough for GRPO, as [required by the bounty](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/1782). per-token advantages pass through `compute_advantage()` → `compute_grpo_outcome_advantage()` when provided, standard GRPO otherwise *note:* also fixed a TOCTOU race in `run_unvicorn()` during development but reverted it after seeing it was independently fixed upstream in #5383. #### recipe (`recipe/atropos/`) subclasses `RayPPOTrainer` and overrides `fit()` to replace verl's rollout+reward phase with atropos API polling. everything else (FSDP sharding, actor optimization, checkpoint management, vLLM lifecycle) is inherited. ``` atropos env (any) → generate_proxy.py (CPU, :9004) → verl internal vLLM (HYBRID, GPU) ↕ sleep/wake FSDP actor (GPU) env scores → trajectory API (:8000) ← trainer polls ``` - generation and training share GPUs via sleep/wake (HYBRID mode) - CPU-only proxy translates between atropos and vLLM request formats, round-robins across replicas for multi-GPU - pause/resume drain prevents CUDA crashes from in-flight generation hitting freed GPU memory during sleep/wake - env-agnostic: switching envs is `ATROPOS_ENV=`, no code changes full implementation details, file listing, and tests in the recipe submodule PR. #### upstream atropos fixes 1 bug fix found during integration, details in the [atropos PR](https://github.com/NousResearch/atropos/pull/408). ### Checklist Before Submitting - [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always` - [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/volcengine/verl/tree/main/docs): full README at `recipe/atropos/README.md` - [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s): 43 pytest tests in `recipe/atropos/tests/` (28 run without GPU/ray). CI yaml not added. atropos is an external dependency. tests run standalone with `pytest recipe/atropos/tests/ -v` - [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in [the `ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1) - [x] Recipe submodule reference updated

the atropos recipe (https://github.com/verl-project/verl-recipe/pull/61) was merged 2 months back and already ships with verl main via the submodule. but this minimal core change opened alongside it that completes the integration (passthrough for pre-computed advantages in GRPO) has seen no activity since open. 

would really appreciate resolving this PR and #1782

## Code Review

This pull request introduces support for pre-computed token-level advantages within the GRPO algorithm, facilitating integration with external RL environments like Atropos. The changes are well-scoped and correctly implemented. Specifically, `verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py` is modified to accept an optional `token_level_advantages` argument in `compute_grpo_outcome_advantage`, bypassing the standard computation when these are provided. Correspondingly, `verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py` is updated to pass these advantages from the data batch. The necessary `httpx` dependency for Atropos integration is also added in `setup.py`. The implementation is clean and effectively achieves the stated goal. I have not identified any issues of high or critical severity.
